problem: Gate 3 security findings 1 and 2 (security_review.md), accepted by the user. (1) Medium, SVG injection: isValidRangeColor (line 17) accepts any non-empty string other than 'transparent', so crafted scene/collab payloads can put url(...) paint-server references or oversized strings into <rect fill>/<tspan fill> on SVG export and into editable.dataset.textRanges. Restrict it to bounded CSS colour tokens only: hex #rgb/#rgba/#rrggbb/#rrggbbaa; rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() with only digits, '.', '%', ',', '/', spaces and optional 'deg' inside the parentheses; or an ASCII-letters-only named colour; total length at most 64 characters after trim; reject 'transparent', url(...), and anything else. Keep the signature `(color: unknown): color is string`. (2) Medium, DoS: normalizeTextRanges (line 25) processes an unbounded ranges array with an O(N^2) loop, and getStyleForTextRange (line ~374) calls `Math.max(end, ...ranges.map((r) => r.end))`, which can overflow the call stack. Add and export `export const MAX_TEXT_RANGES = 512;` and in normalizeTextRanges inspect only the first MAX_TEXT_RANGES entries of the input array; in getStyleForTextRange compute the maximum end with a for loop instead of the spread. Change nothing else; every existing test must still pass.

Gate 3 security finding 3 (Low, availability), accepted by the user: reconcileElements reads element.originalText.length (line 103) and localElement.originalText.length (line 135) directly when 'textRanges' is in the element, which throws a TypeError if a remote collab payload has a text element with textRanges but a missing or non-string originalText. Guard both lookups with `typeof x.originalText === "string" ? x.originalText.length : 0`, and for remote elements use the sanitized normalized array (omit the textRanges key when normalization yields nothing). Change nothing else; every existing test must still pass.
